description: This file contains Swagger API documentation classes for the SavingsAccountTransactions API endpoints in the Fineract project. It defines data transfer objects (DTOs) used for API responses and requests related to savings account transactions, including transaction details, payment info, currency info, charge payments, and bulk reversal requests.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger schemas for savings account transactions API responses and requests.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionsSearchResponse
classes.description: Represents the response for searching savings account transactions, including total count and a set of transaction items.

classes.name: GetSavingsAccountTransactionsPageItem
classes.description: Data model for individual transaction entries, including transaction type, currency, payment details, charges paid, and balances.

classes.name: GetTranscationEnumData
classes.description: Encapsulates transaction type enum data such as ID, code, value, and boolean flags indicating transaction nature.

classes.name: GetTransactionsCurrency
classes.description: Currency details for a transaction, including code, name, decimal places, display symbol, etc.

classes.name: GetTransactionsPaymentDetailData
classes.description: Payment details associated with a transaction, including payment type, account info, check numbers, and routing codes.

classes.name: GetPaymentTypeData
classes.description: Details of the payment type, including ID, name, and whether it is system defined.

classes.name: GetSavingsAccountChargesPaidByData
classes.description: Records charge payment data, including charge ID and amount paid.

classes.name: PostSavingsAccountTransactionsRequest
classes.description: DTO for posting new savings account transaction requests, including date, amount, locale, reason, and payment type.

classes.name: PostSavingsAccountTransactionsResponse
classes.description: Response DTO after creating a transaction, including IDs for office, client, savings, and resource.

classes.name: PostSavingsAccountBulkReversalTransactionsRequest
classes.description: Request DTO for bulk reversal of savings transactions, primarily indicating if the request is bulk.
